dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Observed prominent annular structures feature irregular, high-contrast light perimeters surrounding darker circular or semi-circular interiors. Perimeter edges are non-uniform in thickness, showing a sharp gradient transition from high-intensity white to low-intensity grey/black.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Scattered high-intensity punctate blobs are visible, notably a cluster of small, solid white points in the lower anterior region and individual dots interspersed between the macro-annuli in the dorsal area.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent annular structures in the upper-right quadrant form a distinct scalene triangle. A secondary cluster of rings in the central-right area forms an elongated, irregular quadrilateral arrangement.

other_distinctive_markers: A broad, high-intensity region with low structural definition is located on the upper-left dorsal area, contrasting with the high-definition annular patterns elsewhere.
